top_categories.workout_context: 994 miles. Your legs will beg to quit after 120. This trains the power output you need from mile 130 onward.
At Utrecht Ultra XL, changes in grade or pace can lift effort above threshold before it settles again. Over-unders train that transition while you keep riding.

Road-specific control matters at Utrecht Ultra XL. Practice on mixed lowland and mountain roads: use smooth gear and cadence changes, accelerate deliberately out of corners, and settle quickly back into sustainable power for 994 miles.
45,932ft of climbing on grades that change every minute. You need to switch from seated to standing without losing rhythm.
Utrecht Ultra XL's mixed lowland and mountain roads rewards steady threshold power. Surging and recovering costs more watts than just holding.
Race-pace efforts that mimic Utrecht Ultra XL's demands. Pacing, fueling, and tactical decisions under fatigue. Practice the race before August.
Every hard session works better with a bigger aerobic base. At 994 miles, base fitness is the difference between racing and surviving.
994 miles rewards fat oxidation. This volume work shifts your fuel mix so you're still burning fat at hour 5, not bonking at hour 3.
88–92% FTP is where you'll spend the hardest sustained miles of Utrecht Ultra XL. Train it until it feels boring.
Endurance with intensity spikes baked in. Exactly what 45,932ft of climbing on mixed lowland and mountain roads does to your power file on race day.
Low-cadence force work supports 45,932ft of climbing when the grade lowers cadence. Practice controlled torque while preserving good form.
45,932ft of climbing makes aerobic ceiling relevant when the grade or pace changes. VO2max work supports those hard moments; sustained climbing and conservative pacing remain the spine.

race_overlay.nutrition: For a multi-day 994-mile race, no single calorie total or one-food strategy is credible. Rehearse continuous intake while riding plus substantial meals at planned stops; document carbohydrate, fluid, and sodium intake, resupply cadence, and gut response. Use checkpoints and publicly available services only as the category rules allow, carry backup calories, and complete a full night-riding systems rehearsal.
race_overlay.altitude: Altitude may change sustainable power and recovery at Utrecht Ultra XL. Use conservative pacing and test any travel strategy before the event.
race_overlay.terrain: The course profile at Utrecht Ultra XL rewards specific practice. Include regular rides on mixed lowland and mountain roads to build confidence.

pack_summary: This 10-workout pack focuses on Durability, Over Under, and Road Specific to prepare you for 994 miles of mixed lowland and mountain roads in Utrecht, Netherlands.
